capability: Menu bar and workspace entry points
details: Native menu opens Home, project initialization and launch, Settings, companion apps, and workspace surfaces.
caveat: Source-inspected; no live acceptance test in this audit.

details: Empty query offers window placement, project launch/attach/kill, layers, groups, assistant, Studio, activity, Focus Mode, Settings and project refresh.
caveat: This is the current merged surface; older documentation calls it a separate command palette and lists commands absent from the current browse menu.

details: Typed slash commands expose engine intents; recognized natural-language commands preview the action and placement before Enter executes. Questions can hand off to the workspace assistant.
caveat: Source-inspected; no live acceptance test in this audit.

details: Search merges windows, terminal/session metadata, screen text, projects and applications; selecting a window result focuses that window.
caveat: Screen text depends on enabled indexing and permissions; terminal metadata support varies by terminal.

details: Maximize, centered floating, halves, quadrants, vertical and horizontal thirds, sixths, fourth columns, eighths and edge quarters share one placement model.
caveat: Keyboard, HUD and local voice phrase coverage expose subsets of the full executor vocabulary.

details: Place into arbitrary column/row grids, inclusive rectangular cell spans, and numbered square-grid shorthand.
caveat: Compact human form uses one-based cells; explicit grid wire form uses zero-based cells.

details: Resolve normalized rectangles through the same executor as named positions and grid cells; respect the display visible frame.
caveat: Source-inspected; no live acceptance test in this audit.

details: Distribute visible windows, windows of the frontmost app type, or a selected/app-filtered group inside a region.
caveat: Source-inspected; no live acceptance test in this audit.

details: Place the frontmost window in a least-occupied grid cell, or grow a selected window to available space from the in-place tools.
caveat: Source-inspected; no live acceptance test in this audit.

details: Move one window or a selection to a named/next monitor while retaining each normalized frame; a single window may move and take a canonical placement.
caveat: Accessibility permission is needed; movement outcomes distinguish successful, partial, blocked and unverified operations.

capability: Focus and find a window across Spaces
details: Resolve tagged tmux terminal windows or explicit window IDs, switch Space when needed, raise and focus, and flash a visual border.
caveat: Resolution falls back through CG/AX/AppleScript and differs by permissions and terminal support.

details: Ctrl+Left/Right and mapped gestures switch adjacent Spaces with a landing bezel and edge feedback. The keyboard path uses a Dock swipe under a screen-update freeze.
caveat: Requires Accessibility; uses private macOS facilities with fallback. Source coverage is not a guarantee on every macOS release.

details: Ctrl+Shift+Left/Right exposes the Space landscape for the current display.
caveat: Source entry point confirmed; visual interaction not exercised in this audit.

details: Hold a configured modifier while dragging to reveal targets and a live preview; release over a zone to place. JSON rules set trigger rectangles, placements, priority and opacity.
caveat: Source-inspected; no live acceptance test in this audit.

details: Control+Option hold opens a radial ring or matrix around the cursor; aim at a target and release to place, or release at center to cancel.
caveat: Shares the Control+Option hold with Spatial Lens through an exclusive preference mode.

details: Preview and place the window under the pointer using eight surrounding targets; side placements cycle half/third/two-thirds, with deliberate adjacent-display flicks.
caveat: Preference-selected alternative for the Control+Option hold; no live gesture test performed.

details: Separate per-display window survey with selection, zoom, grouping, grid gather, staged placements and saving selected windows as layers.
caveat: Staged Space reassignment is explicitly Phase 3 in source and must not be advertised as implemented.

details: Select real desktop windows; Fill, Grid and Swap act immediately; Place stages an exact position. Keep accepts changes; Restore reverses the session frames and stacking.
caveat: Source-inspected; no live acceptance test in this audit.

details: Spotlight the frontmost interactive window against a dark backdrop, center/resize it, and restore its original frame on exit.
caveat: Source-inspected; no live acceptance test in this audit.

capability: Letter navigation hints and mouse finder
details: Overlay letter hints on windows for keyboard focus jumps; find or summon the pointer through engine commands.
caveat: Source-inspected; no live acceptance test in this audit.

details: Turn selected live windows into a tab stack; select, add, detach, expand to a grid, collapse, activate, show a guide or dissolve the group.
caveat: These are runtime-only window stacks, distinct from persisted tmux project tab groups.

details: Survey displays/layers; select and search windows; drag/resize, tile, spread, expose, distribute, grow, consolidate or flatten; preview, apply or discard edits.
caveat: Some Screen Map implementation labels predate unified layer semantics. Current Overview dirty changes are being inventoried separately; do not equate screen-map local arrangements with saved layer rules.

details: Search and inspect projects/windows, multi-select for tiling, display window previews and a docked/expanded minimap, and expose voice feedback.
caveat: Pinning here pins the HUD inspector selection; it does not implement always-on-top for arbitrary application windows.

capability: App-owned overlay actors and hover HUDs
details: Apps can publish local HUD manifests and HTML; Lattices hosts a persistent actor with a transparent WebKit hover dashboard and global visibility toggle.
caveat: Host capability requires an app-published manifest/content; the dashboard renderer and data remain app-owned.

details: Map configured mouse buttons, clicks, directional drags and shapes to Space navigation, Screen Map, voice hotkey, arbitrary keyboard shortcuts or app activation; supports action sequences.
caveat: Source-inspected; no live acceptance test in this audit.

details: Load user-level gesture JSON, upsert/reload through the daemon, restore defaults and undo using local history snapshots.
caveat: Machine-local rules are separate from project configuration; source docs specify newest 40 snapshots.

details: Hold Caps Lock for Hyper and tap alone for Escape; preserve/restore the original HID mapping and provide stuck-input recovery.
caveat: Optional and permission-dependent; uses private F18 transport to avoid latching Caps Lock.

details: Record, change, disable and reset action bindings; detect conflicts; bind window, workspace, voice, HUD, layer and arrangement actions.
caveat: Source-inspected; no live acceptance test in this audit.

details: Event Viewer shows mouse/device observations; event-tap circuit breakers expose paused/disabled state and a re-enable control.
caveat: Source-inspected; no live acceptance test in this audit.

details: Quick scans extract Accessibility text without screenshots; deep scans capture/hash windows and run budgeted Vision recognition, caching unchanged results.
caveat: Opt-in. Default quick scan is 5 windows/60 seconds; deep scan 15 windows/2 hours with an OCR budget of 3. Screenshot OCR needs Screen Recording.

details: Persist screen text in local SQLite/FTS5, search by text/app, inspect window history and recent results, and prune old records.
caveat: Retention is configurable, with a current 7-day default; docs/ocr.md still says 3 days.

details: Capture a window, rectangular region or full display; save PNGs as run artifacts and optionally copy to clipboard. Display capture supports delayed snapshot flows.
caveat: Requires Screen Recording. Capture implementation exists, but no new media was captured during this inventory.

capability: Artifact crop, zoom and local visual checks
details: Crop/scale saved images, extract text blocks, verify contains/not-contains expectations, or compare artifact changes.
caveat: The native vision analysis here is local OCR and image-change checking, not general semantic image reasoning by a vision language model.

details: Record a screen region or application window to MOV through a signed app-host ScreenCaptureKit probe; choose region FPS/scale and stop the recording by run.
caveat: Requires supported macOS, Screen Recording and an app bundle. Default window recording is a fixed region; explicit app-window mode follows the app-window path.

details: Keep run status, target surfaces, trace events and media artifacts; inspect completed or failed activity through the app and API.
caveat: Source-inspected; no live acceptance test in this audit.

details: The action runtime supports dry-run placement/movement, target and before/after frame evidence, verification, receipt history and restoration of undoable actions.
caveat: Undo and frame verification apply to the action-runtime path; do not assume every legacy/direct UI action has a durable receipt.

details: Open directly into listening, hold Option for push-to-talk, stop/cancel capture, show transcript/intent/results, execute supported workspace intents and hand conversational questions to the assistant.
caveat: Voice runtime is build-gated; SettingsView.swift:2235-2251 explicitly reports Not in this build when HUDSONKIT_WITH_VOICE is absent. Permissions and configured engines also apply.

details: Voice turns use desktop snapshots, local/inference-backed interpretation and native action execution; preserve frame history, cap action batches and distribute repeated placement requests.
caveat: Requires voice/worker readiness and any selected provider credentials. No latency or live provider-acceptance claim is established by this source audit.

details: The Lattices voice API forwards say/stop/pause/resume/seek/skip, voice selection and speaker leases to the separately installed Voice helper.
caveat: Speech has an independent lifecycle and capability token. A queued speech job is not proof of playback completion; voice.stop means output stop, not stopListening.

capability: Settings, permissions and supported external terminals
details: Settings cover app/project preferences, permissions, keyboard/mouse input, shortcuts, Hyperspace, voice/AI, screen search, companion pairing and Command Deck; launch tmux sessions in Terminal, iTerm2, Warp, Ghostty, Kitty or Alacritty.
caveat: No native embedded-terminal UI was found. LatticesTerminalKit is a reusable terminal-inventory package, not an embedded terminal emulator. Companion and assistant details are audited separately.
